Origin: Acolyte

Jax told Vessa that word of the caravan had come to them through the temple they once served, and waited to see what she would do with that. Vessa glanced up at that, her friendliness going flat for a moment before she nodded like a person filing a fact away. "A temple job," she said. "Fine. That tells me you can keep your mouth shut." Past her shoulder, beyond the tents of Consul Caravan Camp, Jax could see a wagon's tall mast rocking in the wind. Vessa stayed standing in front of them, and she had not yet said anything about the caravan itself.

log.content: Ask Vessa what the caravan looks like

Jax asked Vessa what the caravan actually looked like, and watched her face while she decided how much to give away. Vessa said, "Plain wagons, heavy wheels, too many guards walking bored, which is how hired muscle always looks right before it matters." She tapped two fingers on the table between them, keeping her voice low as a guard passed near the tents. Beyond her shoulder, lanterns were going up along the caravan's picket line, and the guards were changing their walking pattern for the night watch. Vessa stayed put in front of Jax, waiting like she had more to sell.
